senses.sense_definition: Период практической работы для приобретения профессионального опыта или повышения квалификации.

examples.text: Студент успешно прошел <w>стажировку</w> в крупной международной компании.

target_lang_translations.en: The student successfully completed an <w>internship</w> at a large international company.

examples.text: После окончания университета он отправился на <w>стажировку</w> за границу.

target_lang_translations.en: After graduating from university, he went abroad for an <w>internship</w>.

target_lang_definitions.en: A period of practical work experience, often undertaken by students or recent graduates to gain professional skills or improve qualifications.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: The most common term for a period of work experience offered by an organization to students or graduates.
Often used in academic contexts to describe a period of work experience as part of a course.
A period of training, often more formal or structured, typically for a specific professional role.
